nmue13.title: Not at 1 AM
nmue13.caption: Some fights are really just two tired people at 1 AM. Caring can sound like: let's talk at breakfast. Then actually show up for breakfast. Save this for your next late-night spiral.

nmue14.title: You vs. the problem
nmue14.caption: When plans fall apart, it's easy to turn on each other. Move to the same side of the table: it's the two of you against the problem, not against each other. Who's your plan-B person?

nmue15.title: Keep the point, drop the edge
nmue15.caption: You can be right about the point and still owe a sorry for the volume. Apologize for the tone, keep the point, and give them a real chance to hear what mattered to you.

nmue16.title: Hold first, fix later
nmue16.caption: When someone you love is hurting, a five-step plan can feel like homework. Ask first: do you want help, or a hug? Then follow their lead.

nmue17.title: Not in front of everyone
nmue17.caption: A jab in front of everyone lands twice as hard. If it stung, you can say so calmly and save the real conversation for later, just the two of you.

nmue18.title: Your partner, not a jury
nmue18.caption: Friends are there to support you, not to vote on your partner. The disagreement belongs to the two people in it, so start by talking to each other.
